mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The mechanism is active at all times and the direction is positive when FEDFUNDS is low.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.3pp rise in the past month) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing demand (HOUST < 500) combined with weak labor market growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.1% in the past month) signals reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth < 0.1% and HOUST < 500, 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%) signals an impending monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 90) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 90, 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 600) signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 600, 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production (INDPRO < 90) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals a recessionary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 90 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 0.5% signals a slowing economy, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth < 0.5% (quarterly), 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
